Name: Fast Prize Ticket
Author: exarobibliologist
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This speeds up the animation of the Prize Ticket Machine at the Mayor's House so prizes are dispensed MUCH faster! Hold down the button and it will process multiple tickets.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Install Fast Prize Ticket[/*]
[*]Go to Mayor's House with a stack of tickets... ticket machine go brrrrrr...[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]There shouldn't be any requirements... or mods that conflict with this. This mod only modifies the Prize Ticket machine at the Mayor's House (nothing else)[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Fast Prize Ticket
Manifest.Description: Speeds up the prize ticket machine animation at the Mayor's house.
Manifest.Author: Sean Murphy
